configuration.restore_note: cold store reopen per repetition; OS page cache is warm, so this is decode-dominated and labelled

restore_overhead.note: charged once per version restore, never per dependency hop

uncertainty.label: warm page cache, single host, local backend; measured max under-prediction over the fitted samples

outcome.message: no plan satisfies the 1 ns restore SLA; the best unconstrained worst-case bound is 2435048406 ns (point prediction 2042323369 ns + 165964547 ns measured SLA margin + 226760490 ns measured decode uncertainty; calibrations weftfs-s13c/sla-margin/v1 / weftfs-r9/hop-uncertainty/v1)
an SLA claim requires a measured restore-overhead model; set PlanOptions::restore_overhead (or drop the SLA). Treating the whole-checkpoint restore work as zero is the S13 defect

sla_boundary.note: an SLA below these values is refused; the measured restore of the accepted plan is compared against the SLA in the sweep

sla_margin.note: bounds a measured single-host, warm-page-cache environment; it is not a cold-media, different-backend, or fleet promise
